changes: Fixed: Column header in the fire certificate address panel now reads 'Issued By' instead of 'Inspecting Engineer'.
Fixed: NICEIC scheme number now appears as its own row in the declaration block on fire certificates — it was only shown in small text below the signature and not as a proper field.
New: Fire certificate Testing step now opens with all tests pre-selected to PASS — change only the ones that failed or are not applicable.

New: Inspection checks also open pre-set to PASS, with Cables and wiring defaulting to N/A. Tests that don't apply auto-set to N/A based on your system settings (not interlinked, CO alarms absent, mains-only power).
New: Limitations of inspection field now saves what you type and shows suggestions when you start typing — works like the address picker.
New: N/A now shows as a grey pill in the PDF certificate tables, matching the green Pass and red Fail pill style.
Fixed: Device summary bar no longer appears on the fire certificate PDF when no devices were recorded — it is now hidden when the device section was left blank.
Fixed: App update popup now matches the app theme — it was always showing in dark mode even when the app was set to light.
Fixed: App update popup now shows only what changed in the latest update — it was incorrectly listing every update since the beginning.
Fixed: Company logo on fire certificates is now larger and clearer — NICEIC logo is also larger so it no longer appears blurred, and the company name is bigger to fill the header properly.
Fixed: Login page could become completely broken after an update — the app now always loads a fresh copy on startup so this cannot happen again.
New: Calendar picker button added to both Test Date and Next Inspection Date — tap the calendar icon to pick a date without typing.
Fixed: Step tabs now show a green tick only for steps you have actually visited — previously ticking forward by accident made earlier steps appear complete when they had not been filled in.
Fixed: Failed device count on the Detectors step can now be typed manually — it was locked and could not be changed.
New: Test date and next inspection date moved to the first step (Type) so you can set both before filling in any details — includes 6 months and 12 months quick-pick buttons.
Fixed: You can now tap any step tab at the top to jump directly to that step — previously you could only go back to steps you had already visited.
Fixed: App update popup no longer auto-reloads — it now shows Update Now and Update Later buttons so you can choose when to reload.
New: Limitations of inspection field added to the Testing step — note anything you couldn't access or inspect (e.g. concealed cables, locked areas). Prints on the certificate under Test Results.
Fixed: Selecting 'Not interlinked' on the System Details step now automatically marks the Interlinked test as N/A on the Testing step — no need to set it manually.
Fixed: Fire certificate live preview no longer jumps or scrolls when you tap a chip — it now stays exactly where you left it.
Fixed: When a new app update is available, a full popup now appears showing exactly what changed in plain language — the app reloads itself automatically after 5 seconds.
New: Fire certificate Detectors step now shows a Total / Passed / Failed / Tested summary at the top — enter counts directly without adding individual device records. Failed is auto-calculated.
Fixed: Fire certificates no longer require you to add at least one device — you can skip the device list entirely and the device table is hidden from the PDF if nothing is recorded.

New: Fire certificate System Details now auto-selects the correct power supply when you choose a grade — D1 sets mains + battery, D2/F sets battery only, E sets mains only. If you override with a conflicting choice, a warning asks you to confirm.
New: Fire certificate premises step now shows your saved properties when typing an address — pick from your directory with one tap.
New: Fire certificate premises step now has a Pick from directory button to browse all saved properties.
New: Fire certificate client name now shows suggestions from your landlords and agents directory as you type.
Fixed: Responsible Person field on fire certificates moved to the bottom of the client section for a cleaner flow.
Fixed: New version available notification now appears reliably every time an update is published — previously it could miss updates if the page loaded before the update check completed.
Fixed: Fire certificate footer now shows only the certificate reference and page number — the property name was already contained within the reference and was removed.
Fixed: Fire certificate continuation pages no longer repeat the form type or certificate reference in the section header — that information now appears only in the footer.
Fixed: Engineer column on fire certificates no longer repeats the company name (already shown in the main header).
Fixed: Fire certificate page 1 now shows category and grade as short codes (LD3, D2) — full descriptions remain on the system details page.
Fixed: Outcome on fire certificate page 1 is now a clean info field instead of a warning box.
New: Engineer qualification and registration number fields added to Fire Alarm Settings — these now print on the declaration block of every fire certificate.
Fixed: Fire certificate labels incorrectly showed 'Annex G' on domestic FA.1 and FA.2 forms — now correctly labelled Installation Certificate and Inspection & Service Certificate.
Fixed: BS 5839-1 version number corrected on all commercial fire certificates.
Fixed: Fire certificate checklist headings referenced wrong annex numbers — now show correct clause references.
Fixed: Selecting Satisfactory outcome when failure results are recorded now requires a written justification — previously just showed a soft warning.
Fixed: CO alarm Not Applicable reason updated — 'No combustion appliance present' replaces the previous narrower wording.
Fixed: Date of transfer field for change-of-organisation now uses DD/MM/YYYY format consistently.
New: HMO premises now shows a reminder that Grade A under BS 5839-1 may be required.
New: FA.1 certificates now show whether operating instructions were provided to the occupier.
New: Engineer registration/reference number field added to fire certificates.
New: Design/scheme reference field added to FA.1 installation certificates.
New: Override justification (when Satisfactory is issued with failures recorded) is now printed on the certificate.
